2610.04056.title: Discrete Diffusion for Large Graph Generation via Structural Candidate Restriction
2610.04056.paper_summary: Synthesizing realistic graphs at scale is vital when the graphs of interest are large and real-world samples are limited or access-sensitive. Diffusion-based generators have recently driven much of the progress, offering high modeling capacity, but most such methods have quadratic computational complexity and are hence restricted to small-scale networks, currently up to 3k nodes. Existing non-quadratic methods remain limited by memorization issues and a trade-off between scalability and generation quality. Our goal is to generate large graphs whose structural statistics --- e.g., degree distribution, clustering, and path length --- faithfully reflect those of real-world sparse graphs, without resorting to memorizing the training data. We introduce a discrete graph diffusion model that restricts training to a structurally motivated subset of node pairs --- observed edges and their wedge non-edges --- reducing training complexity below quadratic in the number of nodes. To keep the noisy graph informative throughout both the forward and reverse trajectories, we design a three-class absorbing forward process governed by a \emph{degree-aware, floored} cosine noise schedule: unlike a structure-blind schedule that adds noise to every pair identically, ours adapts to each node's degree and never fully erases the graph's structure, keeping the noisy graph informative at every step. Experiments across diverse datasets show that our model consistently ranks among the top methods for structural fidelity against existing discrete diffusion baselines in large graph generation.
2610.04056.paper_summary_zh: 合成大規模的現實圖形至關重要，尤其當感興趣的圖形龐大且現實世界的樣本有限或敏感時。基於擴散的生成器最近推動了許多進展，提供了高建模能力，但大多數此類方法具有二次計算複雜度，因此限制在小規模網絡，目前最多可達 3k 節點。現有的非二次方法仍然受到記憶問題的限制，以及可擴展性與生成質量之間的權衡。我們的目標是生成大型圖形，其結構統計——例如，度分佈、聚類和路徑長度——忠實地反映現實世界稀疏圖的特徵，而無需依賴於記憶訓練數據。我們引入了一種離散圖擴散模型，將訓練限制在一個結構上動機的節點對子集——觀察到的邊和它們的楔形非邊——從而將訓練複雜度降低到節點數量的二次以下。為了在前向和反向軌跡中保持噪聲圖形的信息性，我們設計了一個由 \emph{度感知、底線}餘弦噪聲調度所主導的三類吸收前向過程：與對每對節點一視同仁地添加噪聲的結構盲調度不同，我們的調度適應於每個節點的度，並且從不完全抹去圖形的結構，在每一步保持噪聲圖形的信息性。跨越多樣數據集的實驗顯示，我們的模型在大型圖生成中，始終在現有離散擴散基準中排名前列，保持結構的真實性。
